name: Shabab Guide
landing_text: One route through the whole pack, from your first tree to the Ender Dragon. Chapters open as you reach new places, so you always see what matters now.$(br2)For any recipe, hover the item in JEI (the list on the right of your inventory) and press $(bold)R$(). JEI is always right; this book tells you $(bold)what$() to make and $(bold)why$().
